T0563.title: Affiliate Marketing
T0563.definition: A channel model in which partners are paid for referred traffic, leads, conversions, or sales.
T0563.description: Affiliate marketing pays partners for traffic, leads, conversions, or sales, making it vulnerable to fake traffic, cookie stuffing, self-dealing, and landing-page hijacking. Controls focus on partner onboarding, conversion evidence, abnormal commission patterns, traffic-source transparency, and recovery mechanisms.
T0563.usageExample: Assess Affiliate Marketing related exposure and define the corresponding controls.
